steps.say: Hello bachcho! Aaj hum start karenge Physics Class 12 ka Chapter 4, Moving Charges and Magnetism. Pehle topic se shuruaat karte hain - Magnetic Field.
Magnetic field ek aisi field hai jo current-carrying wire ke aas paas generate hoti hai. Chaliye ek experiment se samajhte hain.
Yeh ek current-carrying wire hai. Iske aas paas ek magnetic compass rakhte hain aur dekhte hain kya hota hai.
Humne dekha ki compass ki needle deflect hoti hai. Iska matlab hai ki wire ke aas paas ek magnetic field generate hui hai.
Ab agar current ka direction reverse karte hain, to needle ka deflection bhi reverse ho jata hai. Yeh ek aur observation hai.
To humne yeh samjha ki current-carrying wire apne aas paas magnetic field banata hai, aur iska direction current ke direction par depend karta hai.
To bachcho, yeh tha introduction to magnetic field. Ab ek chhota sa sawal dekhte hain.

check_question.question: If the current in a wire is reversed, what happens to the magnetic compass near it?
check_question.say: Agar wire mein current ka direction reverse karte hain to uske paas rakhi magnetic compass par kya asar padega?
check_question.explanation: Reversing the current reverses the direction of the magnetic field, causing the compass needle to deflect in the opposite direction.

steps.say: Ab hum samajhte hain ki Magnetic Field ek vector quantity kaise hoti hai.

draw.text: Magnetic Field as a Vector Quantity

steps.say: Magnetic field ka symbol hota hai B, jaise electric field ka symbol hota hai E.
Magnetic field bhi ek vector quantity hai, jaise electric field hoti hai.

draw.text: Magnetic field is a vector quantity.
Electric field is also a vector quantity.

steps.say: Vector quantity ka matlab hai ki iske paas magnitude aur direction dono hote hain.
Ab hum ek example se samajhte hain ki magnetic field kaise ek vector hoti hai.
Yeh ek current-carrying wire hai. Iske around magnetic field generate hota hai.
Magnetic field ka direction current ke direction par depend karta hai.
To dekha, magnetic field ek vector quantity hai, kyunki iska ek direction hota hai.

check_question.question: Magnetic field ek vector quantity kyun hoti hai?
check_question.say: Magnetic field ek vector quantity kyun hoti hai?
options: Kyunki uska magnitude aur direction hota hai
Kyunki woh sirf current se banti hai
check_question.concept: Magnetic field as a vector quantity
check_question.explanation: Magnetic field ek vector quantity hai kyunki uske paas magnitude aur direction dono hote hain.

steps.say: Ab hum samajhte hain ki magnetic field ka effect moving charges par kaise hota hai.

draw.text: Effect of Magnetic Field on Charges

steps.say: Magnetic field stationary charges par koi force nahi lagata, par moving charges par lagata hai.
Ek current-carrying wire ke paas ek charge rest mein rakhein to uspe koi force nahi lagegi.
Agar wahi charge ko move karte hain, to magnetic field uspar force lagata hai aur wo deflect hota hai.
Electric field stationary aur moving charges dono par force lagata hai, par magnetic field sirf moving charges par.

draw.text: Electric field: Force on all charges
Magnetic field: Force on moving charges

steps.say: To bachcho, magnetic field ka effect sirf moving charges par hota hai. Yeh ek important difference hai.

check_question.question: Magnetic field kis par force lagata hai?
check_question.say: Magnetic field kis par force lagata hai?
check_question.explanation: Magnetic field acts only on moving charges, not stationary ones.

steps.say: Ab hum Magnetic Field ki SI unit aur Magnetic Flux ke baare mein samajhte hain.
Magnetic Field ki SI unit hoti hai Tesla, jise T se denote karte hain.

draw.text: Magnetic Field ki SI unit: Tesla (T)

steps.say: Ek aur unit hai, Newton per Ampere meter, yaani N by A meter.
Ab Magnetic Flux ki baat karte hain. Iski unit hoti hai Weber, jise W b se denote karte hain.
Magnetic Flux ko define karte hain B dot A ke roop mein, aur iski unit hoti hai Weber.
Ab ek chhota example dekhte hain. Ek surface area hai jisme magnetic field pass kar rahi hai.
Flux ko calculate karte hain B dot A se. Agar B ka magnitude ek Tesla hai aur area ek meter square hai, to flux hoga ek Weber.
To bachcho, Magnetic Field ka unit Tesla hai aur Magnetic Flux ka unit Weber hai.

check_question.question: Magnetic field ki SI unit kya hai?
check_question.say: Magnetic field ki SI unit kya hoti hai?
check_question.explanation: Magnetic field ki SI unit Tesla hoti hai.

steps.say: Ab hum samajhte hain ki is chapter ka structure kya hai aur kaunse topics cover honge.
Yeh chapter start hota hai magnetic field ke generation se, jaise current-carrying wire ke aas paas field banti hai.
Phir hum calculations seekhenge, jisme Biot-Savart Law aur Ampere's Circuital Law use hote hain.
Aur chapter ke last part mein hum dekhenge ki magnetic field ka effect moving charges par kaise hota hai.
To bachcho, yeh chapter magnetic field ki generation, calculation, aur effects par focus karega.

check_question.question: Which law helps calculate magnetic field due to a current-carrying wire?
check_question.say: Kaunsa law magnetic field calculate karne mein madad karta hai current-carrying wire ke liye?
check_question.explanation: Biot-Savart Law is used to calculate the magnetic field generated by a current-carrying wire.
